event_markers.label: Bridge FX
event_markers.reason: Smooth energy fall and cinematic atmosphere

Slice.description: Samples chopped by slicing technique applied to rhythm percussive elements

Granular.description: Samples chopped by granular synthesis for atmospheric textures

Beat_slicer.description: Samples chopped specifically using beat slicer technique for rhythmic complexity

Chop_and_roll.description: Samples chopped and rolled for smooth transitions and cinematic atmosphere

sound_intent.description: Create a minimal variation Phonk arrangement with cinematic mood emphasizing dynamic rise and fall in energy curve

routing_intent.description: Route sample layers by chop technique channels with clear separation for mixing clarity

track_roles.drums: Rhythm and pulse established by sliced and beat slicer samples
track_roles.bass: Low end support using granular and chop_and_roll samples
track_roles.chords: Harmonic texture focusing on cinematic chords with granular sample chops
track_roles.melody: Sparse melodic hints layered with granular and chop techniques
track_roles.vocal: No vocal presence in this arrangement
track_roles.fx: Cinematic transitions and effects using chopped samples to blend sections

designer_intent.focus: Ensure a clear cinematic mood with minimal variation in arrangement, smooth dynamic transitions, and use of sample chop naming for channel identification

presetor_intent.focus: Bypass temporary arrangement chains while rendering; target clean and dynamic audio output

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using slice and beat slicer sample chop techniques ensuring minimal variation with focus on cinematic rhythm.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass layers from granular and chop_and_roll sample channels matching the cinematic mood and rise/fall energy profile.

harmony_generator.brief: Design chord textures leveraging granular chopped samples maintaining cinematic harmonics with minimal variation.

melody_generator.brief: Add minimal melodic elements using granular and chop_and_roll sample chops to support arrangement mood without overpowering.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure focusing on dynamic cinematic rise and fall energy curve and sectional transitions.

presetor.brief: Manage preset rendering ensuring bypass of temporary arrangement chains and clean audio output for all channels.

songgps.brief: Optimize arrangement sections and energy curve consistent with cinematic mood and minimal variation guidelines.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix channels routed by sample chop technique names ensuring clarity, cohesion and cinematic dynamic expression.
